runner.note: The registry's twenty-five rows already state attack, control, expected outcome and confounder, which is a case definition in all but format. Converting them into cases is the largest and most mechanical of the five empty-suite tasks and is not done here.

cases.title: Accept the anti-cheat registry and resolve every recorded reason code
cases.note: Twenty-five catalogued attacks. This case proves the registry resolves; it executes none of the attacks, and the twenty-five per-attack cases the harness contract requires do not exist.

cases.title: Refuse each wave-four codec and sequence malformation
cases.note: Ten cases: duplicate map key, non-minimal integer, indefinite-length map and their siblings. All ten share the one refusal class, which is why they are one manifest case over one fixture rather than ten.
